chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Not a jazz musician but a musician who plays all kinds of music
summary: He says he likes all kinds of music and mentions an upcoming Palm Springs gig for the Heart Association.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You know, I don't consider myself a Jazz musician. A lot of people do, but I just consider myself a musician who happens to be able to play a little Jazz. Because I like all kinds of music. I dig playing in a symphony occasionally, I dig playing my horn, I love to write. As of now, this coming Saturday, I'm playing a gig in Palm Springs. It's my gig, and Gerry's going to play piano, and I've got Bill Douglass playing drums. It's for the Heart Association.
When I get wound up, I can really chatter...
